channel.title: The Hollywood Reporter - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Hollywood Reporter (hollywoodreporter.com)

item.title: San Francisco Bumps Film and TV Tax Credit
item.description: Productions that film in the area are now eligible for a 20 percent rebate on spending above $1 million, as well as up to $1 million in savings on city fees.

item.title: From Bloomingdale’s to H&M, Retailers Hop on ‘Wuthering Heights’ Movie Merch
item.description: The romance-driven, lace-filled lineup spans fashion, fragrance and home.

item.title: Remembering James Van Der Beek’s Final Onscreen Film Role as Noah Beck’s Father in ‘Sidelined 2’
item.description: As a father to six in real life, stepping into a parental role onscreen was likely somewhat familiar for the 48-year-old actor, who lost his battle with colorectal cancer on Wednesday.

item.title: Ego Nwodim Won’t Be Censoring Herself to Host the 2026 Spirit Awards
item.description: The comedian may very well follow in the footsteps of her beloved 'SNL' character Miss Eggy: "Don't ask for permission, ask for forgiveness," she says.

item.title: James Van Der Beek’s GoFundMe Tops $1 Million in Under 24 Hours After His Death
item.description: The 'Dawson's Creek' and 'Varsity Blues' actor died Wednesday morning following a battle with colorectal cancer.

item.title: Berlin Rising Star Luna Wedler on Discovering Acting: “It Became My Great Love, Almost an Addiction”
item.description: At 26, the German star of 'Biohackers' and 'Silent Friend' can look back on a decade of playing everything from a rom-com sweetheart to a right-wing psychopath: "I just want to play and try everything."

item.title: ‘Jojo Rabbit’ Star Davis Joins ‘Wonderland’ Animated Feature (Exclusive)
item.description: Roman Griffin Davis will lend his voice to the upcoming 3D animated adventure tale from Polish studio Lightcraft.
